extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Hides profanity, accidents, violence and negative sensationalism on news portals and social media.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store. Max 132 characters.

appTagline.description: Subtitle under the product name in the popup header.

filterToggleTitle.message: Turn the filter on or off
filterToggleTitle.description: Tooltip of the main on/off switch.

filterToggleLabel.description: Accessible name of the main on/off switch.

stateOn.description: Short label next to the main switch when the filter is on.

stateOff.description: Short label next to the main switch when the filter is off.

statTitle.description: Heading of the counter of hidden items on the current page.

statChecking.description: Shown while the popup queries the current tab.

statOff.description: Shown when the filter is turned off.

statUnreachable.message: The filter does not run on this page, or the page needs to be reloaded.
statUnreachable.description: Shown when the content script does not run on the current page.

statActive.message: Posts and articles collapsed by the filter.
statActive.description: Explains the counter of hidden items.

loadError.description: Shown when settings could not be loaded.

keywordsTitle.description: Heading of the keyword list card.

keywordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the new keyword input. The examples are Polish keywords on purpose (the filter targets Polish sites).

keywordInputLabel.description: Accessible name of the new keyword input.

keywordHint.message: Enter a word stem to cover all inflected forms (e.g. “tragedi” → tragedia, tragedii). Separate multiple phrases with commas.
keywordHint.description: Help text under the keyword input.

keywordListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of active keywords.

keywordEmpty.message: The list is empty — nothing will be hidden.
keywordEmpty.description: Shown when the keyword list is empty.

restoreDefaults.description: Link that restores the default keywords.

removeKeywordTitle.description: Tooltip of the × button on a keyword chip.

removeKeywordLabel.description: Accessible name of the × button on a keyword chip.

keywordErrorLength.message: A phrase must be $min$ to $max$ characters long.
keywordErrorLength.description: Validation error: phrase too short or too long.

keywordErrorDuplicate.message: This phrase is already on the list.
keywordErrorDuplicate.description: Validation error: the phrase is already on the list.

keywordAddedOne.description: Confirmation after adding a single phrase.

keywordsAdded_one.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: one).

keywordsAdded_few.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: few).

keywordsAdded_many.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: many).

keywordsAdded_other.description: Confirmation after adding phrases (plural form: other).

keywordsSkipped.description: Appended to the confirmation when some phrases were rejected.

defaultsAllPresent.message: All default phrases are already on the list.
defaultsAllPresent.description: Shown when all default phrases are already on the list.

defaultsRestored_one.message: Restored $count$ phrase from the default list.
defaultsRestored_one.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: one).

defaultsRestored_few.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_few.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: few).

defaultsRestored_many.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_many.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: many).

defaultsRestored_other.message: Restored $count$ phrases from the default list.
defaultsRestored_other.description: Confirmation after restoring default phrases (plural form: other).

engineTitle.description: Heading of the evaluation engine card.

engineKeywordsDesc.message: Always on — also used as a fallback for the AI model.

engineActive.description: Badge showing that an engine is active.

engineAiName.description: Name of the local AI engine.

engineAiDesc.message: Text goes only to your own local server or to the built-in model in the browser.
engineAiDesc.description: Description of the local AI engine.

engineAiToggleLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the local AI switch.

aiProtocolLabel.description: Label of the AI request format (protocol) picker.

aiProtocol_simple.description: Option of the protocol picker: ParaBene's own simple JSON contract.

aiProtocol_basal.description: Option of the protocol picker: the basal-serve typed-decision API (a product name, normally not translated).

aiProtocol_builtin.description: Option of the protocol picker: the model runs inside the browser, without a server (WebGPU is a technology name, not translated).

aiProtocolSaved.description: Confirmation after changing the request format.

aiEndpointLabel.description: Label of the endpoint URL input.

aiTest.description: Button that tests the connection to the local model.

aiHint.message: When the model does not respond, ParaBene automatically falls back to keywords.
aiHint.description: Help text under the endpoint input.

aiModelLabel.description: Label of the picker of the built-in model.

aiModelOption.description: Option of the built-in model picker: the model name (not translated) and the size of its file.

aiModelOptionCustom.description: Option of the built-in model picker for the other basal version kept in “Advanced”: its file name (not translated) and size.

aiModelNote_pico.message: The smallest and fastest: about 0.2 s for a short text.
aiModelNote_pico.description: Hint under the model picker for basal-omni-pico (time measured on an Apple M4 Pro).

aiModelNote_mini.message: The default: about 0.3 s for a short text.
aiModelNote_mini.description: Hint under the model picker for basal-2.0-mini (time measured on an Apple M4 Pro).

aiModelNote_custom.message: Another basal version from the “Advanced” section, not tested by ParaBene – you use it at your own risk.
aiModelNote_custom.description: Hint under the model picker for the other basal version.

aiModelMissing.message: The model is not downloaded. Until you download it, the built-in model is off and pages are filtered by keywords.
aiModelMissing.description: Built-in model: the model file is not in the storage of the extension yet.

aiModelTrial.message: Another basal version is being tested (“Advanced” section). Until the test ends, pages are filtered with keywords.
aiModelTrial.description: Built-in model: another basal version is on trial, so the chosen model is not used meanwhile.

aiModelDownload.description: Button that starts the download of the file of the chosen built-in model; the placeholder is its size.

aiModelDownloading.message: Downloading the model: $percent$%. You can close this panel.

aiModelLoading.message: The model is downloaded. Loading it into memory…
aiModelLoading.description: Built-in model: the file is stored and is being loaded.

aiModelStored.description: Built-in model: the model file is in the storage of the extension.

aiModelFailed.description: Built-in model: the download or the start failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

aiModelStoredFailed.message: The model is downloaded but does not work: $error$
aiModelStoredFailed.description: Built-in model: the file is stored but loading it failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

error.example: this browser provides no WebGPU (graphics card)

aiBuiltinHint.message: The model runs in your browser on the graphics card (WebGPU). Its file is downloaded from Hugging Face only when you click “Download model”; page text never leaves the browser.
aiBuiltinHint.description: Help text shown when the built-in model is selected (Hugging Face is the name of the site the model file comes from).

aiErrorInvalidUrl.message: Enter a full http(s):// URL, e.g. $example$
aiErrorInvalidUrl.description: Validation error for the endpoint URL.

aiEndpointSaved.description: Confirmation after saving the endpoint URL.

aiTestText.description: Sample text sent to the local model when testing the connection.

aiConnectedWithReason.description: Connection test succeeded and the model returned a reason.

aiConnectionFailed.message: No connection ($error$). Falling back to keywords.
aiConnectionFailed.description: Connection test failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

aiError_noResponse.description: Connection error: the service worker did not answer.

aiError_invalidResponse.description: Connection error: the model returned malformed JSON.

aiError_unreachable.description: Connection error: the server cannot be reached.

aiError_modelLoading.message: the model is still loading ($percent$% downloaded) — try again in a moment
aiError_modelLoading.description: Built-in model error: the model file is still being downloaded or loaded.

aiError_noWebGPU.message: this browser provides no WebGPU (graphics card)
aiError_noWebGPU.description: Built-in model error: the browser has no usable GPU adapter.

aiError_builtinOff.message: the built-in model runs only while the filter and the local AI model are on
aiError_builtinOff.description: Built-in model error: the connection test was run with the filter or the AI model off, so the model is not loaded.

aiError_modelFailed.description: Built-in model error: loading the model or a decision failed.

aiError_modelMissing.message: the model is not downloaded — click “Download model”
aiError_modelMissing.description: Built-in model error: the model file has not been downloaded (the quoted text is the label of the aiModelDownload button, without the size).

aiError_downloadFailed.description: Built-in model error: the model file could not be downloaded.

aiError_customTrial.message: another basal version is being tested – keywords are used until the test ends
aiError_customTrial.description: Error: the built-in model is not used while another basal version is on trial.

aiError_notFound.message: HTTP 404: the server has no route $path$. For basal-serve, pick the “basal-serve” format and enter just the server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.170:8010
aiError_notFound.description: Connection error: the endpoint answered 404 (wrong path or wrong request format).

aiError_unknown.description: Connection error with a raw technical message.

aiModeLabel.description: Label of the picker that sets how keywords and the AI model work together.

aiMode_both.message: Keywords + AI: hide when either matches
aiMode_both.description: Mode option: a keyword match hides at once, other texts are checked by the AI model.

aiMode_ai.message: AI only (keywords only while the model is unavailable)
aiMode_ai.description: Mode option: the AI model decides alone; keywords are used only as a fallback.

aiSensitivityLabel.description: Label of the sensitivity picker (hide threshold) of the basal models: basal-serve, the built-in model and image evaluation (basal is a model name, not translated).

aiSensitivity_high.message: High — hides more, more false positives

aiTopicsLabel.description: Legend of the topic checkboxes; each checkbox uses a category_* message.

aiTopicsEmpty.message: No topics selected — the AI model will not hide anything.
aiTopicsEmpty.description: Warning shown when no topic is selected.

aiScore.description: basal-serve connection test: hide score and the threshold, appended to aiConnected*.

engineImagesName.description: Name of the optional image evaluation engine (basal-omni is a model name).

engineImagesDesc.message: Sends pictures from posts only to your local server running a multimodal model.
engineImagesDesc.description: Description of the image evaluation engine.

engineImagesToggleLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the image evaluation switch.

aiImagesEndpointLabel.message: Address of the basal-serve server with image support
aiImagesEndpointLabel.description: Label of the image server URL input.

aiImagesHint.message: A separate server: basal-serve --model Remek/basal-omni-1.0-mini --mode eager --media on. One picture takes about 2 s, so only posts near the visible part of the page are checked.
aiImagesHint.description: Help text under the image server URL input; the command line is not translated.

aiImagesConnecting.message: Sending a test picture… (the first request after a server start takes about 15 s)
aiImagesConnecting.description: Shown while testing the image server.

aiImagesConnected.message: Connected ✓ Model $model$ judged the test picture in $seconds$ s.
aiImagesConnected.description: Image server test succeeded; aiScore may follow.

aiImagesConnectionFailed.message: No connection to the image server ($error$). Pictures will not be checked.
aiImagesConnectionFailed.description: Image server test failed; the placeholder is one of the aiError_* messages.

aiError_noImageSupport.message: model $model$ does not take images — run basal-serve with a basal-omni model and --media on
aiError_noImageSupport.description: Connection error: the server's model has no image support.

aiError_imagesNotFound.message: HTTP 404: the server does not know the path $path$. Enter just the address of the basal-serve server running a basal-omni model, e.g. http://192.168.1.170:8011
aiError_imagesNotFound.description: Image server error: the address answered 404 (wrong path).

languageLabel.description: Label of the UI language picker.

barText.description: Text of the bar that replaces hidden content on web pages.

barReason.description: Reason for hiding, shown in the bar.

barReasonAi.description: Reason for hiding given by the AI model after judging the text of the content, shown in the bar.

barReasonAiImage.description: Reason for hiding given by the AI model after judging a picture of the content, shown in the bar.

barReveal.description: Button in the bar that reveals hidden content.

barRevealedText.description: Text of the bar above content revealed with 'Show anyway' while learning is on (the reason follows).

barRevealedNote.message: — if you do not hide it, ParaBene will let similar content through.
barRevealedNote.description: Note after the reason in the bar above revealed content (learning on).

barPassedText.description: Text of the bar above content that would be hidden but is let through because it is similar to a learned example (the reason follows).

barPassedNote.message: — it is similar to content you revealed earlier.
barPassedNote.description: Note after the reason in the bar above content let through by a learned example.

barHide.description: Button in the bar above revealed or let-through content that hides it again (and forgets the example).

reasonUnknown.description: Fallback reason when none is available.

reasonAiDefault.description: Reason used when the AI model hides content without giving a reason.

category_profanity.description: Category name shown instead of the matched profane word.

category_accident.description: Category name: the AI model found an accident, disaster or fire.

category_violence.description: Category name: the AI model found violence, crime, an attack or war.

category_death.description: Category name: the AI model found death, illness or a personal tragedy.

category_politics.description: Category name: the AI model found politics, politicians or a political dispute.

category_clickbait.description: Category name: the AI model found sensationalism or a shocking (clickbait) headline.

sourceKeyword.description: Label of the number of items hidden by keywords on the current page (the number follows).

sourceAiText.description: Label of the number of items hidden by the AI text model on the current page (the number follows).

sourceAiImage.description: Label of the number of items hidden by the AI image model (judging a picture) on the current page (the number follows).

sourcePassed.description: Label of the number of items let through by learned examples on the current page (the number follows).

learnTitle.description: Heading of the card with learning from revealed content.

learnToggleName.description: Name of the switch that turns learning from revealed content on.

learnDesc.message: Content shown with “Show anyway” and not hidden again becomes an example. Similar content hidden for the same reason is then let through, with a “Hide” bar.
learnDesc.description: Explains how learning from revealed content works.

learnSimilarityLabel.message: How similar content to let through
learnSimilarityLabel.description: Label of the select with the similarity required to let content through.

learnSimilarity_strict.description: Similarity option: only nearly the same text is let through.

learnSimilarity_loose.description: Similarity option: content on a similar subject is let through.

learnOff.message: Off — learned examples are not used.

learnEmpty.message: No examples yet — reveal hidden content and leave it shown to teach ParaBene.
learnEmpty.description: Shown when learning is on and there are no examples.

learnSummary_one.description: Number of learned examples (plural form: one).

learnSummary_few.description: Number of learned examples (plural form: few).

learnSummary_many.description: Number of learned examples (plural form: many).

learnSummary_other.description: Number of learned examples (plural form: other).

learnPendingSummary_one.message: $count$ is waiting for confirmation (scroll on or leave the page).
learnPendingSummary_one.description: Number of revealed items waiting to become examples (plural form: one).

learnPendingSummary_few.message: $count$ are waiting for confirmation (scroll on or leave the page).
learnPendingSummary_few.description: Number of revealed items waiting to become examples (plural form: few).

learnPendingSummary_many.message: $count$ are waiting for confirmation (scroll on or leave the page).
learnPendingSummary_many.description: Number of revealed items waiting to become examples (plural form: many).

learnPendingSummary_other.message: $count$ are waiting for confirmation (scroll on or leave the page).
learnPendingSummary_other.description: Number of revealed items waiting to become examples (plural form: other).

learnShowList.description: Summary of the collapsible list of learned examples.

learnListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of learned examples.

learnClear.description: Link that deletes all learned examples.

learnClearConfirm.description: Shown on the forget link after the first click; a second click deletes all examples.

learnSource_keyword.description: Tooltip of a learned example hidden by keywords.

learnSource_aiText.description: Tooltip of a learned example hidden by the AI text model.

learnSource_aiImage.description: Tooltip of a learned example hidden by the AI image model.

learnImageItem.description: A learned example that is a picture (the host it came from).

learnRemoveTitle.description: Tooltip of the × button of a learned example.

learnRemoveLabel.description: Accessible label of the × button of a learned example.

logTitle.description: Title of the card of the log of evaluated content.

logToggleName.description: Switch that turns the log of evaluated content on (also on the statistics page).

logDesc.message: Every evaluated text, the page address and the verdict (keywords or AI) — only locally, to look through on the statistics page.

logOff.description: Shown when the log is off and empty.

logEmpty.message: No entries — evaluations will be recorded while you browse.
logEmpty.description: The log is on and empty.

logDownload.description: Button on the statistics page that exports the log as a JSON Lines file.

logClear.description: Link that deletes all log entries.

logClearConfirm.description: Shown on the clear link after the first click; a second click deletes the log.

logClearFailed.description: Shown in place of the log summary when clearing the log failed.

logSummary.description: Summary of the log in the panel.

logOpenStats.description: Button in the panel that opens the statistics page in a tab.

logReadFailed.description: The log database could not be read.

statsTitle.description: Title of the statistics page (ParaBene is the product name).

statsLead.message: What ParaBene evaluated while you browsed, and with what result. The data stays in this browser.

statsLogOffNote.message: Recording is off — new evaluations are not added.
statsLogOffNote.description: Notice on the statistics page: the log is off but has entries.

statsLogOffEmpty.message: Recording is off. Turn on “Record evaluated content” and browse — the evaluations will appear here.
statsLogOffEmpty.description: Notice on the statistics page: the log is off and empty (the quoted text is the logToggleName message).

statsEmpty.description: Empty state of a table or list on the statistics page.

statsNoMatch.description: Empty state of the entries list when filters exclude everything.

statsTileShown.description: Headline number: contents that were not hidden.

statsTileCorrected.description: Headline number: verdicts the user corrected.

statsTilePeriod.description: Headline: the dates of the oldest and newest entry.

statsSites.description: Number of sites under the period.

statsSourcesTitle.description: Title of the table by source of the verdict.

statsColSource.description: Column and filter: what gave the verdict.

statsColShown.description: Column: number of contents not hidden.

statsSource_keyword.description: Source of a verdict: the keyword list.

statsSource_aiText.description: Source of a verdict: the AI text model.

statsSource_aiImage.description: Source of a verdict: the AI image model.

statsSource_fallback.description: Source of a verdict: keywords used because the AI model did not answer.

statsScoresTitle.description: Title of the histogram of hide scores.

statsScoresHint.message: Number of texts ($count$) by score from 0 to 1. Current hide threshold: $threshold$.

statsScoresAria.message: Histogram of the scores of $count$ texts; hide threshold $threshold$. The numbers are in the table below.

statsScoresEmpty.message: No evaluations by the AI model with a score.

statsScoresTable.description: Opens the table with the numbers of the histogram.

statsLegendThreshold.description: Legend of the histogram: the dashed line.

statsColRange.description: Column of the histogram table: the score range.

statsSitesTitle.description: Title of the table of sites.

statsColSite.description: Column and filter: the site (host name).

statsColShare.description: Column: percent of hidden contents on the site.

statsSitesAll.description: Button under the table of sites.

statsSiteUnknown.description: A site without a host name.

statsSiteFilter.message: Show the entries of this site

statsEntriesTitle.description: Title of the list of evaluated contents.

statsScore.description: The model score of an entry and the threshold at that time.

statsScoreOnly.description: The model score of an entry.

statsTopicNone.description: The topic "none of the hidden topics" in the list of probabilities.

statsOpenPage.message: Open the page in a new tab
statsOpenPage.description: Tooltip of the link to the page of an entry.

statsMarkShow.description: Correction button on a hidden entry.

statsMarkHide.description: Correction button on a shown entry.

statsFlagRevealed.description: Flag of an entry: the user clicked "Show anyway".

statsFlagLearned.description: Flag of an entry: a learned example let it through.

statsFlagRepeated.description: Flag of an entry evaluated more than once.

reviewTitle.description: Title of the card that sends entries to an external model.

reviewLead.message: You can send the entries to an external model (an OpenAI-compatible API or Claude) that judges them independently and proposes a verdict. Only the text of an entry and the list of hidden topics are sent — no page addresses. Nothing is sent until you confirm it.
reviewLead.description: Explanation of the review card (OpenAI and Claude are product names).

reviewEndpointLabel.description: Label of the field with the address of the API.

reviewModelLabel.description: Label of the choice of the model, and of the model column in the table of batches.

reviewKeyLabel.description: Label of the field with the API key.

reviewKeyHint.message: The key is stored only in this browser, is not part of the settings backup and is sent only to the server it was saved for.
reviewKeyHint.description: Note under the API key field.

reviewKeyCleared.message: Another server or kind of API: the saved key will not be sent there. Enter the key for this API.
reviewKeyCleared.description: Shown when the key field was emptied because the form now points at another server or kind of API than the key was saved for.

reviewSave.description: Button that saves the API address, model and key.

reviewSaved.description: Confirmation after saving the API settings.

reviewInvalidEndpoint.message: Enter a full http(s):// address, e.g. $example$
reviewInvalidEndpoint.description: Validation error of the API address.

reviewNeedConfig.message: Enter the API address and choose a model, then save.
reviewNeedConfig.description: Shown instead of the number of entries while the API is not configured.

reviewNoTopics.message: You hide no topic, so there is nothing to judge.
reviewNoTopics.description: Shown when no hidden topic is selected in the panel.

reviewCandidates.message: To send: $count$ (entries of the current filter with a text and no proposal; at most $max$ at a time).
reviewCandidates.description: How many entries a click would send.

reviewSend.description: Button that opens the confirmation before sending.

reviewConfirm.message: You will send the text of $count$ entries (up to 2,000 characters each) to $host$, model $model$. Page addresses and ParaBene verdicts are not sent.
reviewConfirm.description: Confirmation before sending entries to the external model.

reviewConfirmExpired.message: Nothing was sent: the entries or settings the confirmation named have changed (e.g. the log was cleared, some entries were sent from another tab or other settings were saved). Click “Send for review…” again.
reviewConfirmExpired.description: Shown when the open confirmation was closed because an entry it named was removed, reviewed or sent meanwhile, or the saved reviewer settings changed.

reviewDone.description: Result of a finished review run.

reviewStopped.description: Result of a review run the user stopped.

reviewFailed.description: Result of a review run that an error stopped; the first placeholder is a reviewError_* message.

reviewError_rate.message: the API limits the number of requests, try again later

reviewError_invalid.message: the answer of the model is not in the expected format
reviewError_invalid.description: Review error: the answer could not be read.

reviewError_batchKey.message: save the Claude (batch) settings with the key for $host$
reviewError_batchKey.description: Review error: a batch cannot be checked because the saved settings are not the Claude API on the server the batch was sent to (the saved key is not sent elsewhere).

reviewError_unknown.description: Review error without a message of its own.

reviewProviderLabel.description: Label of the choice between the kinds of API the reviewer model is reached through.

reviewProvider_openai.description: Kind of API: any OpenAI-compatible chat completions API (OpenAI is a product name).

reviewProvider_claude.description: Kind of API: the Claude API, where all entries go as one batch answered later (Claude is a product name).

reviewNeedConfigClaude.message: Choose a model and enter the API key, then save.
reviewNeedConfigClaude.description: Shown instead of the number of entries while the Claude API is not configured.

reviewConfirmBatch.message: You are about to send the text of $count$ entries (up to 2,000 characters each) as one batch to $host$, to the model $model$. Page addresses and ParaBene's verdicts are not sent. The answer comes later, usually within an hour.
reviewConfirmBatch.description: Confirmation before sending entries to the Claude API as one batch.

reviewBatchSending.description: Shown while a batch is being sent.

reviewBatchCheck.description: Button that asks the API for the state of the batch.

reviewBatchCancel.description: Button that asks the API to stop the batch.

reviewBatchCheckFailed.description: Shown when a request about the batch failed; the placeholder is a reviewError_* message.

reviewBatchNotSent.description: Shown when the batch could not be created; the placeholder is a reviewError_* message.

reviewBatchFirstError.description: Added to the result of a batch with errors: the message of the first one, as the API gave it.

reviewError_api.description: Review error: an HTTP error status with the API's own message.

reviewModelCustom.description: Last choice in the list of models: a model name typed by hand.

reviewModelCustomLabel.description: Accessible name of the field for a model name typed by hand.

reviewModelsRefresh.description: Button that asks the API which models it has.

reviewModelsFetched.description: Confirmation after the list of models was fetched.

reviewModelsFailed.message: Could not fetch the list of models: $error$.
reviewModelsFailed.description: Shown when the list of models could not be fetched; the placeholder is a reviewError_* message.

reviewModelHint.message: The model is the one that reviews the entries: a larger one is usually more accurate and costs more. “Fetch the list of models” asks the API (with the key entered) which models are available.
reviewModelHint.description: Note under the API settings explaining the choice of the model.

reviewMissingModel.message: Choose a model from the list or type its name.

reviewInvalidModel.message: The name of a Claude model starts with “claude-”, e.g. $example$. Choose a model from the list.
reviewInvalidModel.description: Validation error: a typed model name the Claude API cannot know.

reviewBatchesTitle.description: Title of the table of batches sent to the Claude API.

reviewBatchColId.description: Column: the identifier the API gave the batch.

reviewBatchColEntries.description: Column: how many entries the batch contains.

reviewBatchColSent.description: Column: when the batch was sent.

reviewBatchColStatus.description: Column: the state of the batch.

reviewBatchColActions.description: Column (name for screen readers): buttons of the batch.

reviewBatchStatus_in_progress.description: State of a batch: being processed.

reviewBatchStatus_canceling.description: State of a batch the user cancelled, until the API has stopped it.

reviewBatchStatus_ended.description: State of a finished batch; unanswered = cancelled or not reached in time.

reviewBatchRemove.description: Button that takes a batch off the list (for a waiting one that cannot be reached, this gives up its answers).

reviewBatchHint.message: The answer usually comes within an hour, after 24 hours at the latest. This page checks once a minute; you can close it and come back later. Entries of a waiting batch are not sent again.
reviewBatchHint.description: Note under the table of batches.

reviewSummaryReviewed.description: Part of the summary of the review; also a button that lists these entries.

reviewSummaryAgree.description: Part of the summary of the review; also a button that lists these entries.

reviewSummaryOverHidden.description: Part of the summary of the review; also a button that lists these entries.

reviewSummaryMissed.description: Part of the summary of the review; also a button that lists these entries.

reviewSummaryPending.description: Part of the summary of the review; also a button that lists these entries.

reviewSummaryShow.message: Show these entries in the list
reviewSummaryShow.description: Tooltip of a number in the summary of the review.

reviewSummaryHint.message: Click a number to see those entries. These are the model's proposals: one becomes a correction only when you accept it, so the filter “Corrections” does not show them.
reviewSummaryHint.description: Note under the summary of the review.

reviewAcceptAll.message: Accept the proposals of the current filter ($count$)
reviewAcceptAll.description: Button that accepts all undecided proposals among the filtered entries.

reviewAcceptAllConfirm.description: The same button after the first click.

reviewSuggestionHide.description: Proposal of the external model for an entry.

reviewSuggestionShow.description: Proposal of the external model for an entry.

reviewAgrees.description: The proposal equals the verdict ParaBene gave.

reviewAccept.description: Makes the proposal the user’s correction.

reviewFilterLabel.description: Filter of entries by the external model’s proposal.

reviewFilter_agree.description: Filter of the entries: the model's proposal agrees with the verdict.

reviewFilter_pending.description: Filter option: disagreements neither accepted nor rejected.

keywordsExport.description: Link that saves the keyword list to a text file.

keywordsImport.description: Link that opens a file with keywords to import.

customModelTitle.description: Heading of the part of “Advanced” where another basal version can be tried.

customModelWarning.message: For advanced users. ParaBene is tested with the basal versions in the “Model” list. Another version may be slower, judge content wrongly or put a heavy load on memory and the graphics card – you change it at your own risk. A new version goes through a self-test and is used only after you click “Keep”. If you do not, or if the browser is closed or hangs, ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customModelWarning.description: Warning above the field for another basal version.

customModelUrlLabel.message: Address of the model file on Hugging Face
customModelUrlLabel.description: Label of the field for the address of another basal version.

customModelUrlHint.message: A *-decision.gguf file from a Remek/basal-… repository, pinned to a commit (40 characters): https://huggingface.co/Remek/basal-…/resolve/<commit>/<file>-decision.gguf. At first the field holds the address of the current default model – change it to the version you want.
customModelUrlHint.description: Format of the address of another basal version; the field is pre-filled with the default model's address as an example.

customModelCheck.description: Button that checks the address and asks Hugging Face for the size of the file.

customChecking.message: Checking the file on Hugging Face…
customChecking.description: Status while the size of the file is being asked for.

customNeedsBuiltin.message: Another basal version can be tried only with the “Built-in model” request format (“Evaluation engine” section).
customNeedsBuiltin.description: Shown when another request format is chosen.

customInfoOk.description: The checked file: its name and size.

customInfoLarge.message: $name$: $size$ GB – more than the $limit$ GB the models were tested with. A model this large may take a lot of graphics memory and slow the browser down.
customInfoLarge.description: The checked file is large: the user has to confirm the risk.

customInfoTooLarge.message: $name$: $size$ GB – too large (the limit is $limit$ GB). A model this large could make the browser hang, so it cannot be downloaded.
customInfoTooLarge.description: The checked file is above the hard limit.

customModelConsent.message: I understand the risk and download a large, untested version on my own responsibility.
customModelConsent.description: Checkbox that must be ticked before a large file can be downloaded.

customStart.description: Button that downloads the other version and runs its self-test.

customDownloading.message: $name$: downloading, $percent$%. You can close this panel.
customDownloading.description: Trial: the file is being downloaded.

customLoading.description: Trial: the model is being loaded.

customTrialHint.message: Until the test ends, pages are filtered with keywords. If the browser starts misbehaving, close it: after a restart ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customTrialHint.description: Trial: what happens meanwhile and how to get out of it.

customTested.description: Trial: the self-test passed; the user may keep the version.

customKeep.description: Button that keeps the tested version; the placeholder is the time left (m:ss), after which the default model is used again.

customReject.description: Button that rejects the tested version.

customKept.message: You use another basal version: $name$ ($size$ GB). It is in the “Model” list of the “Evaluation engine” section.

customRemove.description: Button that removes the kept version and its file.

customReverted.message: Last time the browser did not finish loading this version (it hung or was closed), so ParaBene went back to the default model. You can choose it again in the “Model” list.
customReverted.description: The kept version was unchosen after a load that never finished.

customDismiss.description: Button that hides the message about a rejected version.

customRejected_testFailed.message: $name$ failed the self-test and the file was removed. ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customRejected_testFailed.description: The trial ended: the self-test failed.

customRejected_tooLarge.message: $name$ turned out to be too large, so the download was stopped. ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customRejected_tooLarge.description: The trial ended: the download was larger than the limit.

customRejected_expired.message: $name$ was not kept in time and the file was removed. ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customRejected_expired.description: The trial ended: “Keep” was not clicked in time.

customRejected_restart.message: The test of $name$ was interrupted by a restart of the browser or the extension, and the file was removed. ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
customRejected_restart.description: The trial ended: the browser or the extension started again before the version was kept.

customTestTime.description: Self-test: the longest time of one decision (text of ~500 characters).

customTestSlow.message: That is slower than the tested versions: content may be hidden with a delay.
customTestSlow.description: Self-test: the version is slow but within the limit.

customTestTooSlow.message: Slowest decision: $seconds$ s – above the limit of $limit$ s.

customTestVerdictsOk.message: The sample texts were judged as expected ($expected$ of $total$).
customTestVerdictsOk.description: Self-test: all sample verdicts were the expected ones.

customTestVerdictsOff.message: Note: only $expected$ of $total$ sample texts were judged as expected – this version may hide the wrong content.
customTestVerdictsOff.description: Self-test: some sample verdicts were not the expected ones (a warning, not a failure).

customTestError.description: Self-test: the error that stopped it.

error.example: this browser does not offer WebGPU

customError_customInvalidUrl.description: Error: the address does not match the required format.

customError_customBuiltin.message: This is the address of a built-in model (from the “Model” list). Change it to the address of another basal version.
customError_customBuiltin.description: Error: the address is that of a built-in model (the example the field starts with).

customError_customNotFound.message: This file was not found on Hugging Face. Check the repository, the commit and the file name.

customError_customInfoFailed.description: Error: the Hugging Face API did not answer as expected.

customError_customTooLarge.message: The file has $size$ GB, more than the limit of $limit$ GB.
customError_customTooLarge.description: Error: the file is above the hard limit.

customError_customConsent.message: Tick that you understand the risk of downloading a large file.
customError_customConsent.description: Error: a large file without the confirmation.

customError_customNotBuiltin.message: Choose the “Built-in model” request format first.
customError_customNotBuiltin.description: Error: another request format is chosen.

customError_customNotTested.message: There is no tested version to keep.
customError_customNotTested.description: Error: “Keep” without a version that passed the self-test.

customError_customExpired.message: The time to keep this version is up. ParaBene uses the model chosen in the “Model” list again.
